label: s32_st_ellery_the_sign_off
title: Countersigned
summary: Ms. Ellery exists and has never appeared. Canon is explicit that she is not a conspiracy -- she is a person with a filing system and a job -- so her first scene is her doing the job: countersigning a week of boxes and being mildly pleased the column adds up. ART GAP: no sprite, so she plays as a labelled placeholder, which is the honest state of the production.
